title: Hormuz saw serious traffic disruption, but the record doesn’t prove a sustained full closure
summary: Visible tanker counts dropped sharply in mid-July and insurers treated passage as riskier, while conflicting “open/closed” statements persisted and AIS gaps mean a total shutdown wasn’t established.
